channel.title: HackTheBox on Sholim
channel.description: Recent content in HackTheBox on Sholim

item.title: Principal
item.description: An Easy Windows Active Directory machine involving anonymous SMB enumeration, .NET binary reverse engineering, LDAP credential extraction, and a Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) attack to achieve Domain Admin.

item.title: Dream Job-2
item.description: An in-depth Threat Intelligence investigation of the Hack The Box Sherlocks challenge Dream Job-2, focused on malware used by the Lazarus Group during Operation Dream Job. This analysis covers malware lineage, macro-based initial access, payload staging, and defensive detection opportunities

item.title: HookFlare
item.description: An Android DFIR investigation of the HTB Sherlocks challenge HookFlare, reconstructing an SMS-based phishing attack, malicious app behavior, permission abuse, and encrypted data exfiltration.

item.title: Sherlock: PhishNet (HTB Challenge)
item.description: An in-depth forensic investigation of a phishing email from the HTB Sherlocks series. We analyze email headers, SPF validation, and a disguised malicious attachment used in a spearphishing attack.

item.title: Cypher
item.description: A full walkthrough of the Hack The Box ‘Cypher’ challenge from Season 7
